quarterly_data.signal: August 2026 monthly revenue (company release, unaudited): consolidated net sales revenue of NT$ 44,690 million, a 1.88% increase month-over-month and a 560.85% increase year-over-year (July 2026: NT$43,867,609 thousand; August 2025: NT$6,762,501 thousand). Year-to-date consolidated sales revenue was NT$ 220,194 million, a 638.19% increase year-over-year.
